name: multi-layout-accordion
title: Multi Open Accordion
description: A single column of FAQ rows that can all be expanded at once. Each question opens its answer in place and stays open while others are opened, without collapsing the rest.
use: You want a compact FAQ where readers can compare several answers without reopening each one.
avoid: With everything expanded the page gets long, and the demo shows only three short answers.
a11y: Rows rely on the pale header to show open, and the header markup is not shown, so focus is unverified. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A single column of dark rounded question bars under a small heading, each row ending in a chevron. Open rows show a pale header and a block of grey answer text below, with up to three answers visible at the same time.
behaves: Clicking a question toggles its answer open or shut with a short height animation. Because the list allows multiple open at once, opening one leaves the others expanded, so all three answers can be shown together.
customise: The three questions and answers are typed into the JSX, and the initially open item is set by a default value. Row styling comes from the shared accordion pieces.
weight: light: Three text rows with a height transition when toggled.
